outcome: Prediction of PAS requiring cesarean hysterectomy using MRI textural analysis
cohort: Sixty-two women with prior cesarean delivery referred for MRI because of sonographic suspicion for PAS
finding: Textural features on placental MR images, particularly in the region of the prior uterine scar, were able to differentiate between pregnancies requiring cesarean hysterectomy for suspected PAS and those that did not, suggesting potential predictive value of these radiomics features.
